stories.title: Mason neighbors fight data center over noise, power and water strain
stories.dek: Residents near Mason are organizing against a proposed data center, citing concerns over constant noise, heavy electricity demand and water use. The project would sit in Ingham County, where local infrastructure and power rates could feel the impact. Michigan readers 30 miles away should watch because similar proposals are surfacing across mid-Michigan townships facing the same trade-offs between jobs and quality of life.
stories.source_title: Community opposes proposed data center near Mason - WLNS 6 News

stories.title: U-M locks in $1.2B Ypsilanti data center site over township objections
stories.dek: University of Michigan has confirmed the Ypsilanti location for its massive new computing facility. Local officials in the township say they will continue fighting the project. Residents 30 miles away could see higher power rates and water strain if the $1.2 billion campus moves forward.
stories.source_title: U-M affirms Ypsilanti $1.2B computing center site; township officials vow fight - The Manchester Mirror

stories.title: State utility regulator eyes rate hikes tied to data center demand
stories.dek: Michigan's power commission wants to change how utilities recover costs for new transmission lines and substations. Data centers are driving much of the projected load growth in the state. Ratepayers across the Lower Peninsula could see bigger monthly bills if the changes are approved.
stories.source_title: Michigan regulator seeks utility rate changes - Axios

stories.title: Kalamazoo weighs year-long pause on all new data centers
stories.dek: City commissioners will vote tonight on a moratorium that would stop any fresh data-center proposals while planners study power and water limits. Kalamazoo residents could avoid sudden spikes in utility bills if the pause gives time to line up new generation. The measure also responds to complaints about noise and truck traffic from similar projects elsewhere in Michigan.
stories.source_title: Data center moratorium on Kalamazoo city commission agenda tonight - WNWN-FM

stories.title: Coldwater Officials Hold First Joint Meeting on Data Center Zoning and Regulation
stories.dek: City Council, Planning Commission and Board of Public Utilities convene tonight for an informational session on managing potential data center development, though no proposals are currently active in the area.

stories.title: Marshall drops charges after threats tied to data center fight
stories.dek: Calhoun County officials say no one will face charges over threats made during heated debates on a proposed data center. The decision comes as the city council weighs tax breaks and power upgrades for the project. Local residents worry about rising utility bills and industrial noise.
stories.source_title: Marshall Police say no charges will be filed in threats to city council, urge civility - WTVB

stories.title: Branch County cities to hash out data center rules Monday
stories.dek: Two local governments in Branch County will hold a joint session to discuss how to handle incoming data center proposals. Residents 30 miles away could see new rules on power use and noise if the talks produce changes. The meeting comes as utilities and developers eye sites across southern Michigan.
stories.source_title: Joint city meeting on data centers set for Monday evening - WTVB

stories.title: Wixom Council Backs Zoning Rules to Limit Data Center Noise and Utility Costs
stories.dek: The 4-3 vote advances changes during the 180-day moratorium for a proposed 600,000-square-foot project on 54 acres, after residents raised concerns over power demand, water use, and noise that could raise household bills.

stories.title: Wixom tightens data center rules amid power and water concerns
stories.dek: Wixom is advancing new regulations for data centers as residents express concerns over potential impacts on local power, water resources, and noise levels. The move aims to address community worries while accommodating technological growth. This decision could set a precedent for other Michigan towns facing similar challenges.
stories.source_title: Wixom, Michigan, advances data center rules as worries grow over power, water, and noise - sustainableconstruction-now.com

stories.title: Mason City Council to Resume Debate on Nearby Data Center Proposal and Noise Ordinance
stories.dek: Council members will discuss a proposed hyperscale facility in Vevay Township and potential amendments to a citizen-initiated noise ordinance at Monday's meeting.

stories.title: Mason revives data center tax fight as Jackson eyes personal property rules
stories.dek: Residents in Ingham and Jackson counties are watching new local rules that could decide how much data centers pay in taxes. The debate affects household electric bills and township budgets if big projects move forward. Mason’s return to the issue shows communities are still sorting out who pays for the power these facilities demand.
stories.source_title: What Roth's Watching: Jackson personal property ordinance, data center debate returns to Mason, and more - WKAR

national.title: Data centers advance rapidly as regulators scramble for rules
national.dek: Across the U.S., officials race to impose guardrails on power-hungry facilities while communities push back on incentives and impacts.
